name: switch
description: A settings toggle following the ARIA switch pattern: a <button role="switch"> with aria-checked, toggled by click and Space/Enter. Works controlled (checked + onCheckedChange) or uncontrolled (defaultChecked). The synchronous switch — for a server-committed toggle that rolls back on failure, use optimistic-toggle.

notes: role=switch with aria-checked, so assistive tech announces it as a toggle and reads its on/off state
A native <button>, so it's focusable and activated by Space/Enter
Needs a label via aria-label, aria-labelledby or a wrapping label; shows a visible focus-visible ring

intents: a boolean preference control (notifications, dark mode)
